digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 plan review chunk and agent pool
propositions: The 6-wide pool submits all chunks and agent futures concurrently, causing each of the first ~6 calls to redundantly write the byte-identical system prefix to cache, wasting ~3.7x the ideal token budget.

When shared-prefix token count exceeds CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and there are >=2 Pass-1 calls, a single-turn warm call must complete serially first to populate the cache before the remainder fan out to the pool.
Non-systemic warm-call failures must gracefully fall back to direct fan-out of the remaining calls without aborting the review.
The warm-then-fan-out implementation degrades to direct fan-out when shared-prefix tokens are below the gate threshold or when only a single call exists.
Cache instrumentation metrics must record exactly one cache write (warm call) and N-1 cache reads (fanned-out calls) for the shared prefix.
